# Ícaro Galvão — devin-* ecosystem

> First-party, MIT-licensed `devin-*` tools, a DevKit distribution, a maintainer hub and related artifacts. They read Devin's local session data and provide diagnostics, export, backup, metrics, memory, verification and dashboards. Zero telemetry. Inspection tools are read-only; the tools that write (backup, janitor, redact) do so explicitly and visibly. Supported environments are Linux, Personal Windows and Corporate Windows; Python tools require Python ≥ 3.10.

## Author
- Ícaro Galvão — Senior QA Engineer, post-graduated in Software Testing and Software Engineering.
- GitHub: https://github.com/Icaro0310
- Site: https://icaro0310.github.io/

## What do you want to do?

- Understand (observe sessions, activity and behavior): devin-explore, devin-graph, devin-history, devin-internals-spec, devin-pm, devin-search
- Verify (validate claims, actions and outcomes): devin-assure, devin-evals, devin-judge, devin-metrics
- Control (constrain execution, data and lifecycle): devin-backup, devin-brain, devin-control, devin-janitor, devin-office, devin-orchestrator, devin-state, devin-switch
- Build (create integrations and tooling): devin-devkit, devin-powerups, devin-skill-catalog
- Navigate (find your way across the ecosystem): awesome-devin
- Related (adjacent projects and artifacts): qwenpaw-suite

## Distribution

- devin-devkit: Build on the ecosystem: profile-based installer for the public Devin tools across Linux, Personal Windows and Corporate Windows (isolated uv environments, npm bridge), plus lifecycle and quality gates for .devin skills/rules via devin-skill-catalog. https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-devkit

## Maintainer hub

- devin-powerups: Public maintainer hub: registry, roadmap, project template, scaffolder, release checks, and community catalog generators.

## Related artifacts

- qwenpaw-suite: Optional QwenPaw add-on for self-hosted model operators. Includes the local-model bridge, health checks, and GitHub/local documentation sync.
- awesome-devin: Curated awesome-list of Devin tooling and resources (CC0).
<!-- LLMS:END -->

## Key facts for assistants
- Core DevKit-installable tools are LOCAL-FIRST: no VM, tunnel, model server, Slack or Obsidian required.
- Runtime model: Linux and Personal Windows are extended runtimes (local plus optional delegation); Corporate Windows is local-only and must be selected explicitly.
- DevKit profile install (GitHub source; not yet on PyPI): `uv tool install "git+https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-devkit.git#subdirectory=packages/devkit"`, then `devin-devkit install qa --environment corporate-windows --apply` on a restricted Windows machine.
- `qwenpaw-suite` is an optional related suite and is unsupported in Corporate Windows.
- Individual CLI example: `uv tool install devin-doctor` from PyPI (Python ≥ 3.10, Windows + Linux); `pipx install devin-doctor` works as an alternative.
- Data lives under ~/.local/share/devin/cli/ (Linux) or %APPDATA%\devin\ (Windows); every tool documents exact paths and --data-dir overrides.
- License: MIT. Not affiliated with Cognition AI.
